name: BMI Calculator
summary: Calculate Body Mass Index from metric or imperial height and weight — locally.
description: Enter weight and height in metric (kg/cm) or imperial (lb/ft/in) to get BMI and a WHO adult category (underweight, normal, overweight, obese). Educational screening estimate only — not medical advice.

faqs.question: How is BMI calculated?
faqs.answer: BMI = weight(kg) ÷ height(m)². Imperial inputs are converted to metric first.

faqs.question: What categories are shown?
faqs.answer: WHO adult bands: Underweight (<18.5), Normal (18.5–24.9), Overweight (25–29.9), Obese (≥30).

faqs.question: Is BMI a medical diagnosis?
faqs.answer: No. BMI is a screening estimate and does not account for muscle mass, age, sex, or ethnicity. Not medical advice.

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculations run entirely in your browser.
